review.notes: Full review at the head the previous review read. Dependency check: 0 problems. Automatic checks all passed. Small corrections: description omits the twist in Theorem 10.1(i) (open since the previous review); the general Theorem 1.9(4) is attributed to ClassicalSerreModularity I.3, which states only Khare-Wintenberger's four prescriptions (sufficient for every use); 'repeats unchanged' holds for four of twelve Lean names.
